title: Design System: Cédophe ZOHOUN — Case File Portfolio

display.purpose: The hero statement only; uppercase, compressed, and balanced.

section-title.purpose: Section openings paired with a Fiche or Annexe folio.

body-large.purpose: Hero lede and the first profile paragraph.

label.purpose: Functional 11px mono labels, rail tabs, and record keys; never sentence copy.

note.purpose: Sentence-bearing captions, form disclosure, and footer copy at 12px or larger.

shadows.name: report-sheet
shadows.purpose: Lifts the single report sheet off the manila desk in the light theme.

shadows.name: rail-lift
shadows.purpose: A shallow lift for the sticky folder index.

shadows.name: scrolled-header
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed header after the page begins to scroll.

shadows.name: report-sheet-dark
shadows.purpose: The dark-theme sheet elevation with heavier ambient falloff.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button, link, hover, and focus-adjacent state changes.

motion.name: surface-shift
motion.purpose: Header background and shadow change on scroll.

motion.name: declassify
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance for the declassified annex.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global stop under prefers-reduced-motion; content remains visible.

narrative.overview: The site is an open case file on a manila desk, not a portfolio template. A fixed file header, a tabbed index rail, and one continuous report sheet carry the entire story. The visitor should feel they are reading a record that was already in use: stamped headers, ruled registers, typed measurements, punched margins, and a red signal used for status rather than decoration. The world is physical and restrained. Manila board and cream paper establish the surface hierarchy; navy ink carries the argument; steel blue handles metadata and measurement; signal red marks the active tab, the verified credential, and the next action. Depth comes from paper and folder layering, not from floating cards. Rounded containers, soft glass, gradient text, and centered hero scaffolding belong to a different world. Copy is evidence-led and first-person. Counts, vendors, and deployments do the persuading; the interface stays quiet enough for them to be read. French is the default voice and English is a complete mirror, not a fallback.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous report sheet with a fixed case-file header and a left index rail.
Warm manila and paper surfaces against navy ink and steel metadata, with one red signal.
Sharp corners, 1px rules, punched margins, and monospaced record labels.
Compressed uppercase display type balanced by generous reading type.
Bilingual FR/EN parity, keyboard-visible focus, and a full dark inversion of the same paper world.
No invented evidence: the only shipping rasters are the two logo cutouts derived from the user's originals.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is never a surface fill on the page. It marks state, verification, or a chosen action; if more than a small fraction of the viewport is red, the hierarchy has failed.

rules.name: The Paper Swap Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is a full inversion of the same material system, not a tinted light mode. Every surface, text, rule, selection, scrollbar, and focus color swaps together; no element keeps a light-theme surface by accident.

rules.name: The Ruled Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type may shout; metadata may whisper; body copy must remain comfortably readable. Functional microtext never drops below 11px, and sentence-bearing notes stay at 12px or larger.

rules.name: The Single Sheet Rule
rules.body: The page is one continuous document. Do not break it into a grid of cards, floating tiles, or separate panels; use ruled sections and typographic hierarchy to separate ideas.

rules.name: The Flat File Rule
rules.body: Inside the sheet, surfaces are flat. Tinted paper, hairlines, and typography create hierarchy; inner cards and stacked shadows do not.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Nothing interactive or informational is rounded into a pill. A rectangle with a 1px edge is the default shape; the only exceptions are the 6px status dots.

dos: Do build every section on the ruled sheet: 1px rules, paper tints, and monospaced filing labels.
Do keep the hero display uppercase, condensed, balanced, and between 3.3 and 5.5rem on desktop.
Do use Signal Red only for active state, verification, field indices, and primary hover.
Do use color-mix() tints of existing tokens for washes, hover fills, and placeholders.
Do keep FR/EN strings in mirrored data-fr/data-en attributes and keep those elements text-only.
Do preserve the fixed header, the sticky index rail, and the single report-sheet composition.
Do raise sentence-bearing small copy to 12px; reserve 11px for functional labels and metadata.
Do keep all motion removable under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce while leaving content visible.
Do keep every fact traceable to PRODUCT.md and every raster attached to its provenance.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pill buttons, glass panels, gradient text, or floating stat tiles.
Don't turn the page into a centered hero, card grid, or dashboard.
Don't use red as a large surface fill or decorative wash.
Don't add shadows inside the sheet; the sheet itself is the only large elevation.
Don't use gray text on the manila or paper surfaces; tint secondary text from the surface hue or use Ledger Steel.
Don't swap a system font for Alumni Sans, Albert Sans, or JetBrains Mono.
Don't add certification badges, project screenshots, client logos, testimonials, or live links that do not exist.
Don't present the contact form as a delivery mechanism; it is a client-side demonstration only.
Don't hide content behind animation; the page must read without JavaScript.
